acceptance.assertion: The canonical Commonworld model contains separately documented, bounded and versioned dimensions for data openness, software openness and governance control or participation, including explicit unknown and not-applicable states rather than forcing a positive or negative claim.

Every non-unknown openness or governance value can reference primary-source evidence and observation dates; validators reject unsupported, contradictory or overbroad claims such as treating use of an open-source component as proof that an entire platform is open source.

Existing catalog and Commons-basis records migrate deterministically. Records are marked unknown where current evidence is insufficient, and no bulk migration infers openness from names, themes or third-party descriptions.

Public catalog detail and, where useful, filtering can expose the three dimensions independently with locale-safe labels and accessible explanations. mundraub.org is representable as operator-led with unproven full data and software openness without being excluded as Commons infrastructure.

Schema tests, admission tests, validation, deterministic generation, full make validate, browser smoke and required GitHub checks pass on the exact proposed head; generated release and evidence artifacts are updated only through canonical generators.

approval.note: The task may evolve generic catalog and admission schemas, validators, rendering and generated releases in an isolated worktree. It must not retroactively infer openness from project reputation or component licenses.

goal: Replace free-text-only openness caveats in Commonworld admissions with evidence-bound, comparable dimensions for data openness, software openness and governance control, without inferring openness where evidence is absent.

does_not_establish: that openness is required for every Commons classification
that open-source dependencies make a platform open source
permission to rewrite historical evidence without fresh source review
automatic merge, deployment or production-verification authority
metadata.observed_gap: Data openness, software openness and operator-versus-community governance are stored only in prose limitations, preventing consistent comparison and filtering.
metadata.source: Follow-up from Commonworld mundraub.org admission in PR #190 on 2026-08-05

rollback.strategy: If the new fields destabilize catalog compatibility or encourage unsupported classifications, revert schema, migration, UI and generated release changes together while retaining focused fixtures that demonstrate the ambiguity of free-text-only openness notes.

title: Model data, software and governance openness explicitly
